# Feedback and support

CrUX Announcements are made to our public [Announcements Google Group](https://groups.google.com/a/chromium.org/g/chrome-ux-report-announce) and included in our [Release notes](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/crux/release-notes).

We would love to hear your feedback, questions, and suggestions to help us
improve Chrome User Experience Report (CrUX). Join the conversation on our public
[Google Group](https://groups.google.com/a/chromium.org/forum/#!forum/chrome-ux-report).

There are a number of channels to receive support, depending on the type of
support required:

[chrome-ux-report](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/tagged/chrome-ux-report) on Stack Overflow
:   For questions about particular queries.

[CrUX discussion](https://groups.google.com/a/chromium.org/g/chrome-ux-report) on Google Groups
:   For general questions about the dataset.

[Google Cloud support](https://console.cloud.google.com/support)
:   For formal BigQuery support.

[Google Search Central Help Community](https://support.google.com/webmasters/community)
:   For questions regarding Google Search's use of CrUX data
